title: negation
description: The involution that swaps the two sides of evidence - positive for an assertion becomes evidence against and vice versa, informational content unchanged. The operation that makes a pre-bilattice a bilattice.

operation.description: a unary operation ~ on the value space

truth-antitone.description: a <=_t b implies ~b <=_t ~a - well-supported-true becomes well-supported-false

knowledge-monotone.description: a <=_k b implies ~a <=_k ~b - informational content preserved

involution.description: ~~a = a - negating twice restores the original
